channel.title: Financials and holding companies: Korean small and mid-cap filings
channel.description: New filings from Korean small and mid-cap companies in the financials and holding companies sector.

item.title: HDC Holdings: HDC subsidiary IPARK Hyundai Development won a KRW 350.1bn construction contract for Jinju Dodong Block B apartments from affiliate IPARK I&Cons.
Dongwon Industries: Dongwon Industries reported Q3 2026 separate revenue of KRW 273.3bn and operating profit of KRW 12.5bn, with a net loss.
Hyundai G.F. Holdings: Hyundai G.F. Holdings reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 1.97tn and operating profit of KRW 65.3bn.
AK Holdings: AK Holdings subsidiary AKIS signed a KRW 3.42bn AIRBRS upgrade contract with Incheon International Airport Corporation.
